description: This file defines the RouteCollectorProxyInterface interface for the Slim Framework, specifying methods for route management such as adding routes for various HTTP methods, setting base paths, and redirecting.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Returns the ResponseFactoryInterface instance used by the route proxy.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the CallableResolverInterface used to resolve callables for routes.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the container associated with the route proxy, which may be null.

methods.name: getRouteCollector
methods.description: Returns the RouteCollectorInterface instance managing the routes.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieves the base path for the route group.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for the route group and returns the interface for chaining.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Adds a GET route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Adds a POST route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a PUT route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Adds a PATCH route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds a DELETE route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Adds an OPTIONS route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Adds a route for any HTTP method with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a route with multiple HTTP methods.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Defines a route group with a pattern and callback.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Adds a route that performs an HTTP redirect from one URI to another.
